events.name: TCS New York City Marathon

fee.summary: 2026 entry was a few hundred dollars, higher for non-members. This file does not store a single fee because published figures differ by membership.

events.summary: Race day is Sunday 1 November 2026. Packet pickup is in person at the Jacob K. Javits Convention Center from Thursday 29 October through Saturday 31 October. There is no race-morning bib pickup and no proxy pickup.
events.watchOut: Bib pickup closes 30 minutes before the expo hall. Bring photo ID and your confirmation.

events.name: Tokyo Marathon

fee.summary: About JPY 19,800 for runners in Japan and about USD 230 for international runners. Confirm the figure on the entry page; published amounts have differed by source.

odds.summary: Recent general lotteries have accepted roughly one in ten applicants. The 2027 rate was not published as a guarantee.

events.summary: The general lottery ran from 11:00 on 14 August to 17:00 on 28 August 2026, Japan time. Results went out on 18 September, with payment due by 30 September. There is no second general draw for 2027.
events.watchOut: A win is not a bib until the fee is paid. Miss the payment window and the place is released.

events.name: Boston Marathon

fee.summary: USD 260, charged when a qualifier is accepted.

odds.summary: No public ballot. For 2027 the accepted field was 25,630 qualifiers, with a cutoff 5 minutes 17 seconds inside the published standard.

events.fieldNote: 25,630 qualifiers accepted for 2027, including about 1,000 drawn from runners who hit the standard but missed the cutoff.
events.summary: Boston has no public lottery. Qualified runners registered from 14 to 18 September 2026, closing at 17:00 Eastern. Acceptances started on 29 September and the fee is charged on acceptance. Charity is the route in without a qualifier.
events.watchOut: A qualifying time is not a bib. Entry goes to the fastest applicants in each age group, and the real cutoff usually sits inside the published standard.

milestones.label: Registration opens
milestones.note: Qualifier registration week opened on Monday 14 September 2026. The opening hour is not stored.

milestones.label: Registration closes
milestones.note: Registration closed at 17:00 Eastern on Friday 18 September 2026.

milestones.label: Acceptances
milestones.note: The B.A.A. began sending acceptances on 29 September 2026. 25,630 qualifiers were accepted. The cutoff was 5:17 inside the standard.

milestones.label: Payment
milestones.note: The fee is charged as acceptances go out. There is not a separate public payment deadline.

milestones.label: Expo
milestones.note: 2027 expo dates are not published. The 2026 expo ran the Friday to Sunday before the race at the Hynes Convention Center. Do not treat that pattern as a 2027 date.

milestones.label: Race day
milestones.note: Monday 19 April 2027, Patriots' Day. The countdown uses the calendar day, not a wave start.

events.name: TCS London Marathon

fee.summary: UK ballot entry is GBP 79.99. International ballot entry is higher; published figures differ, so confirm the current fee. The GBP 49.99 double-chances option, where it was offered, already covered entry.

odds.summary: The 2027 ballot received 1,338,544 applications. Only a share of the weekend field is allocated through the ballot, so the practical odds are very long.

events.fieldNote: About 100,000 starters across Saturday 24 April and Sunday 25 April 2027.
events.summary: The ballot ran from 09:00 on 24 April to 16:00 on 1 May 2026. Results were emailed on 9 July 2026. Winners had to confirm by 16:00 on 31 July. Good for Age entry for UK residents closes at 16:00 UK time on 29 October 2026. Charity places are separate.
events.watchOut: Ballot winners are allocated Saturday or Sunday. In 2027 the men's Good for Age field is scheduled for Saturday and the women's for Sunday. Places are not interchangeable.

milestones.label: Ballot opens
milestones.note: Opened at 09:00 British Summer Time on Friday 24 April 2026.

milestones.label: Ballot closes
milestones.note: Closed at 16:00 British Summer Time on Friday 1 May 2026.

milestones.label: Ballot results
milestones.note: Results were emailed through Thursday 9 July 2026. The organiser asked applicants to get in touch if nothing had arrived by 09:00 on Friday 10 July.

milestones.label: Confirm entry
milestones.note: Successful applicants had to confirm details, and pay any balance, by 16:00 British Summer Time on Friday 31 July 2026.

milestones.label: Good for Age opens
milestones.note: UK residents with a qualifying time. The window opened on 1 October 2026. The opening hour is not stored. About 6,000 places, fastest first, so the standard alone does not guarantee a place.

milestones.label: Good for Age closes
milestones.note: Closes at 16:00 UK time on Thursday 29 October 2026. Clocks have gone back, so this is GMT.

milestones.label: Expo
milestones.note: Bib pickup is in person at the London expo, usually at ExCeL. 2027 dates are not published in this file.

milestones.label: Race weekend
milestones.note: Saturday 24 April and Sunday 25 April 2027. Your confirmation says which day you have. The countdown starts at the beginning of Saturday in London.

events.name: Sanlam Cape Town Marathon

fee.summary: The ballot application fee was ZAR 5. The race fee is charged if you are drawn. The race-fee amount is not stored here.

odds.summary: No acceptance rate has been published for the 2027 ballot.

events.summary: Cape Town joins the World Marathon Majors at the Sunday 23 May 2027 edition, the first Major in Africa. The 2027 ballot ran from 10 to 24 June 2026, with results notified on 26 June. There is no time-qualifier standard. Charity and tour operators remain open after the draw.
events.watchOut: The application fee is not the entry fee. A successful draw charges the race fee.

fee.summary: AUD 280 for Australian residents and AUD 330 for everyone else, charged if you are drawn. Entering the ballot is free.

odds.summary: The 2026 ballot accepted roughly one in three applicants. The 2027 rate is not out yet.

events.watchOut: There is no separate payment window. If you are drawn, the card you entered is charged.

events.name: Generali Berlin Marathon

fee.summary: EUR 215 if you are drawn, plus EUR 5 if you want bag drop. Nothing is charged unless you are selected.

odds.summary: The organiser does not publish the acceptance rate in advance.

events.summary: The 2027 lottery opened on 1 October 2026 and closes on 12 November 2026. Everyone who entered is emailed a result on 3 December. If you are selected, payment is taken from 4 December and can take up to a week to clear. Fast-runner entry, the Jubilee Club, charity, and tour operators are separate routes.
events.watchOut: A deferred runner's voucher for 2027 also expires at 23:59 CET on 12 November 2026. Treat that clock time as the last safe moment on closing day, and confirm the lottery form's own hour if you are applying late.

events.name: Bank of America Chicago Marathon

fee.summary: USD 250 for US residents and USD 260 for everyone else, plus a processing fee. Collected only after the application is approved or drawn.

odds.summary: Recent general drawings have accepted roughly a quarter of applicants. The 2027 rate is not published in advance.

events.summary: Guaranteed and non-guaranteed applications opened at 08:00 Central on 8 October 2026 and close at 14:00 Central on 29 October 2026. It is not first come, first served. Guaranteed applicants must pay by 23:59 Central on 10 November. Drawing results are emailed on 8 December, and drawn runners must pay by 23:59 Central on 15 December.
events.watchOut: Miss the payment deadline that applies to your path and the place is released. You will not get a bib.
